verdict.summary: Round 1's major accuracy issue is resolved. The HTTP-server guidance now correctly distinguishes a retained generation's full logical snapshot from its physical representation: Graph::fork Arc-shares immutable permutation indexes and planner statistics, shares the frozen dictionary and numeric/temporal cache bases, and copies the pending overlay/extensions; compaction creates fresh storage while older retained generations keep their prior shared base resident. The conservative sizing advice is therefore accurate without hard-coded measurements. The other edits appropriately remove non-canonical fixed benchmark and bundle-size figures without changing API guidance. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in this documentation-only diff.
